title: How To Add Google Calendar To Squarespace Easy Integration 2026
description:
Here is the full procedure on How To Add Google Calendar To Squarespace Easy Integration 2026.

How to Add Google Calendar to Squarespace – Step-by-Step Tutorial

Welcome back to Endless Guides!
In today’s video, we’re going to show you how to add Google Calendar to your Squarespace website so you can keep your visitors updated with real-time events, appointments, and schedules.

Step 1: Log into your accounts
First, log in to your Squarespace account.
If this is your first time, click Create Account and follow the instructions on the screen.

Next, open a new tab and head to your Google Calendar.
This is where you’ll get the code to embed Google Calendar in Squarespace.

Step 2: Get your Google Calendar embed code
In Google Calendar, click the gear icon in the top right and select Settings.

From the left-hand side, scroll to the calendar you want to use.
Click the calendar name—for example, "Business Events" or "Class Schedule"—and then select Integrate Calendar.

Look for the Embed Code section.
This code will let you display a calendar on a Squarespace page.

You can customize the calendar appearance and choose whether to show one or multiple calendars.
Once ready, copy the embed code to your clipboard.

Step 3: Embed the calendar into Squarespace
Now, switch back to your Squarespace dashboard.

Go to the page where you want to show your calendar

Click Edit

Click Add Block, and then choose the Code Block

Click the pencil icon and paste the Google Calendar embed code

You’ll now see your live Google Calendar on your Squarespace site.
Feel free to drag the block and place it where it fits best.

Benefits of adding Google Calendar to Squarespace
By connecting Google Calendar to Squarespace, any updates you make to your calendar will automatically reflect on your website.
This means your visitors will always see the latest updates—whether it's appointments, webinars, classes, or public events.

It’s a perfect solution for anyone looking to add a live calendar to Squarespace and improve user engagement.

You can also use this to:

Create a public event calendar in Squarespace

Add a Google Calendar widget to your Squarespace homepage

Embed multiple calendars on different Squarespace pages

And that’s it!
Now you know how to integrate Google Calendar with your Squarespace website the right way.

If you found this guide helpful, don’t forget to like, subscribe, and check out our other videos on Squarespace customization and event management tools.

Thanks for watching, and we’ll see you in the next one!

title: How to Add a Coming Soon Page on Squarespace 2026, Enable Maintenance / Under Construction Page
description:
Here is I will show you How to Add a Coming Soon Page on Squarespace 2026, Enable Maintenance or under construction page Easily.


In today’s video, I’ll show you how to add a coming soon page on Squarespace — step by step.
Whether you’re preparing for launch, redesigning your site, or just working behind the scenes, a coming soon page keeps your visitors informed and builds excitement.

We’ll cover two easy methods: one using a landing page, and another using password protection — both ideal if you want to hide your Squarespace website during development or simulate Squarespace maintenance mode.

Let’s get started.

✅ Method 1: Use a Cover Page or Landing Page as Your Homepage
Step 1 – Create a New Page

Log in to your Squarespace account and open your dashboard.

Go to Pages, then scroll to the Not Linked section.

Click the + button and choose Blank Page or Cover Page — a great way to create a minimal landing page on Squarespace.

Name it something like Coming Soon or Under Construction.

Step 2 – Design the Page

Add a bold heading like “Launching Soon” or “We’re Building Something New”.

You can include a coming soon banner, short message, your logo, social media links, or even an email capture form in Squarespace to start building your subscriber list early.

Use page sections and style settings to match your brand.

Step 3 – Set it as the Homepage

Hover over the new Coming Soon page and click the ⚙️ Settings icon.

Scroll down and enable Set as Homepage.

Hit Save.

Now your coming soon page is live. Visitors will only see this page, while the rest of your site stays hidden in the Not Linked section.

✅ Method 2: Use Site-Wide Password Protection
This method is perfect if you want to enable Squarespace maintenance mode or block access entirely during your build.

Step 1 – Go to Site Availability

From the main dashboard, click Settings - Site Availability.

Step 2 – Enable Password Protection

Select Password Protected, enter a password, and write a short message like “Site Coming Soon” or “Check Back Soon.”

Click Save.

This will password protect your Squarespace site, and only users with the password can view it.

💡 Pro Tip: Combine this with your coming soon or email capture page, so even while your site is locked, you can still collect emails from early visitors.

And that’s it!

That’s how to add a coming soon page on Squarespace, whether you need a simple under construction page, or a secure password protected site during development.

If you found this helpful, give it a like, subscribe for more Squarespace tutorials, and drop your questions in the comments.

Thanks for watching!
